data.overview: **Quick overview:** AIVideosUGC helps shops, dropshippers, small businesses, agencies, creators, and app teams create product visuals without a traditional shoot. The Partner Program gives approved creators and agencies a dedicated channel, a Pro demo workspace, and a dashboard.

company.title: Company Overview
paragraphs: **AIVideosUGC is an online service operated by BLYDEY INC**, focused on preparing product photos and short videos for online stores and marketing channels. Shops can start from product information they already have, choose a suitable creative direction, and review the generated result before downloading.

The platform brings image and video workflows, AI presenters, templates, and review options together in one place. It serves DTC brands, online shops, SaaS teams, and agencies, helping them prepare product visuals for listings, seasonal promotions, and product updates.

subBlocks.title: Where we started
paragraphs: AIVideosUGC was founded in 2026 to help small shops produce product visuals without the cost and scheduling of a traditional shoot. The first workflows focused on turning a single product photo into a usable product clip; the platform has since grown into a workspace that covers URL to Video, Image to Video, Text to Video, AI presenters, and reviewable drafts.

solutions.title: What We Do
paragraphs: AIVideosUGC is built around familiar shop tasks: **showing what an item looks like, explaining one useful detail, and preparing a version for a chosen channel.** The platform offers two main starting points — **a product link** or **a product photo** — and from there shops choose a scene or an AI presenter, shape the message, and generate images or short videos.

process.title: From a product photo to a reviewed result
paragraphs: Every job follows the same path: add your product, choose a scene or presenter, review the storyboard, generate the shots you select, and download the result. The credit cost is shown before each step, and failed jobs return credits automatically.

The platform offers creative options; product knowledge and the final publishing decision stay with the shop. Shops should ensure claims are accurate, use images and voice material they own or have permission to use, and review the product, wording, and presentation against each channel's rules before publishing.
items: Credit cost is shown before each photo or video job starts.
If a job fails, reserved credits are automatically returned to your balance.
Unused credits remain on your account for the period stated in the plan terms; credits are not transferable between accounts.
Uploaded photos and voice material are used to produce the visuals you request. Retention and deletion terms are described in the [Privacy Policy](/privacy).
Some channels require disclosure or labeling for AI-generated content. Shops are responsible for checking each platform's rules and adding any required labels before publishing.

comparison.title: Why Shops Choose AIVideosUGC
paragraphs: A traditional shoot or a creator arrangement has clear strengths. AIVideosUGC is built for shops that need to produce, review, and repeat product visuals without arranging a shoot each time.

partners.title: Grow with AI video ads your audience can actually try
partners.lead: **The AIVideosUGC Partner Program** is designed for partners who already talk to creators, sellers, and agencies, letting them share AIVideosUGC with their audiences. Approved partners receive **a dedicated promotion channel, a Pro demo workspace, and a dashboard**; the platform handles onboarding, support, and the render pipeline.

items.title: Short-form creators
items.text: TikTok, Reels, and Shorts educators whose feed is product ads — their viewers already ask which tool made them.

items.title: Newsletter & community owners
items.text: Ecommerce and dropshipping lists that recommend tools weekly and want a link their readers can actually use.

items.title: Agencies & freelancers
items.text: Teams delivering video ads for clients can resell the workflow they already run.

items.title: Performance partners
items.text: Media buyers running paid traffic can point to a product-first tool with a free entry workflow.

partners.criteriaNote: Review criteria do not include a minimum follower count. We evaluate audience fit, honest creative framing, and a willingness to disclose the partnership and respect audience data.

steps.title: Apply
steps.text: Tell us who you reach and where you publish. Every application is manually reviewed within 48 hours.

steps.title: Get your channel
steps.text: Approved partners receive a tracking link, a dashboard, and a Pro demo workspace for producing demos.

steps.title: Publish
steps.text: Tutorials, comparisons, behind-the-scenes — any format that shows what the tool does. Ready-to-use copy is included.

steps.title: Grow with us
steps.text: Tell us what resonates with your audience, and we'll keep providing campaign briefs, creative assets, and partner support as you publish.

benefitCols.title: What Partners Receive
items: **A dedicated tracking link** — referrals are tracked via a 90-day cookie on your channel link.
**A dashboard** showing every referral and its status.
**A Pro demo workspace** for producing demos.
**A creative kit** delivered with the approval email.
**Ongoing support** — campaign briefs, creative assets, and partner support as you publish.
**Recurring commission on referred subscriptions** — rates and payment terms are shared with your approval email and in the partner terms.
benefitCols.note: Paid, email, and organic traffic are all welcome. Brand-keyword bidding and misleading creatives are not permitted.

benefitCols.title: Free Credits for Creators
items: Post a video with **#AIVideosUGC** and submit it; once approved, your account receives **20 free credits** — enough for a full 15-second video.
Creators with larger audiences can earn **up to 60 credits**.
Every application is manually reviewed, and you will receive an email either way.
You must be logged in to your creator account to apply; credits go directly to that account.

items.q: Who gets approved for the partner program?
items.a: Creators, agencies, and community owners whose audience makes or markets video content: ecommerce sellers, TikTok and Reels educators, dropshipping communities, marketing newsletters, and agencies. There is no minimum follower count; we evaluate fit and activity.

The approval email includes your tracking link, dashboard invite, and creative kit. Partner terms, shared before anything goes live, explain how referrals are recognized and what commission rates apply. The dashboard shows every referral and its status.
Your channel link sets a 90-day cookie. Any subscription opened within that window is attributed to you.

items.q: Can I run paid ads as a partner?
items.a: Yes. Paid, email, and organic traffic are all welcome. We only ask that you do not bid on our brand keywords or run misleading creatives; full details are in the partner terms.

items.q: What happens after I submit the partner application form?
items.a: Your application enters our partner review queue. You will receive an email within 48 hours; approved partners receive their dashboard invite, channel link, and creative kit in the same email.

items.q: How does AIVideosUGC handle uploaded photos and voice material?
items.a: Uploaded photos and voice material are used to produce the visuals you request. Shops should only upload content they own or have permission to use. Retention and deletion terms are described in the Privacy Policy.

items.q: What happens to credits if a job fails or is not used?
items.a: If a job fails, reserved credits are automatically returned to your balance. Unused credits remain on your account for the period stated in the plan terms; credits are not transferable between accounts.

items.q: Does AI-generated content need platform-specific labeling?
items.a: Some channels require disclosure or labeling for AI-generated content. Shops are responsible for checking each platform's rules and adding any required labels before publishing.
